name: Flat sardinella
description: Flat sardinella (Sardinella maderensis), tracked as its own compartment by the source (the model's richest fish at 13.5 t·km-2, catches ~82 000 t·yr-1). Slightly more zooplankton-dependent than its round cousin; together the two sardinelles supply around 70% of declared landings and anchor the artisanal fishery.
